title: 菊花賞の後に・静かなる宣言

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower, overcome with emotion after winning the Kikuka Sho, is confronted by Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Frustrated by her loss, Bourbon acknowledges Rice Shower as her rival and challenges her to another face off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower accepts the challenge and, in a voice loud enough for the audience to hear, declares she will win the next race as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to enter the Nikkei Sho so that her abilities can continue to bloom.
